GOAL: Provide durable deterministic recovery for abandoned PROCESSING directive dispatches after an unexpected worker termination, without duplicate execution or duplicate authorized output.
SCOPE: packages/queue/jobs.ts only if queue redelivery coordination must change
scripts/queue-e7.mjs only if needed for exact runtime evidence
REQUIRED_BEHAVIOR: An interruption after ENQUEUED->PROCESSING claim cannot leave a required run permanently stuck without a repository-owned recovery path.
Recovery must prove the previous execution authority is abandoned before another worker may execute authoritative work.
At most one active execution authority exists for a run at a time.
COMPLETED/CANCELLED and LAW-authorized final outputs remain terminal and cannot be replayed into a second execution.
Recovery timing and ownership use deterministic or explicitly authoritative state; no silent host-clock authority.
BUSY remains valid for a genuinely live concurrent owner but cannot permanently mask an abandoned claim.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Do not generically change every PROCESSING row back to ENQUEUED.
Do not infer abandonment solely from untrusted queue payload fields.
Do not create duplicate SWARM/JUDGE/LAW executions or duplicate durable releases.
Do not introduce host-clock authority into canonical recovery without active authority.
Do not mutate NEXY.AI-Test-AI directly while isolated worker branch law remains blocked.
ACCEPTANCE: A deterministic test establishes PROCESSING, simulates worker interruption before complete/fail persistence, then exercises recovery/redelivery.
The run safely resumes exactly once or reaches an explicit fail-closed recoverable state according to the verified design; it does not remain permanently PROCESSING.
A concurrent live owner cannot be stolen.
Terminal COMPLETED/CANCELLED and released outputs are never re-executed.
Recovery evidence is durable and independently reviewable.
Existing queue cancellation, failed-retry, dispatch reconciliation, and release-atomicity tests remain green.
Independent review and exact-SHA post-integration reverify complete.
UNBLOCK_CONDITION: Authoritative policy establishes a Git-valid isolated worker branch namespace or explicitly authorizes an equivalent isolation mechanism.
